AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good. The check is correctly placed: tgt_hpreq_handler() runs tgt_request_preprocess() before ofd_hp_brw()/mdt_hp_brw() install rq_ops, so the hpreq callbacks and the NRS policies can no longer see an ioo_bufcnt larger than the niobuf array, and osc_brw_prep_request() always sets ioo_bufcnt to the same niocount it passes to req_capsule_set_size(), so no in-tree client can trip the new -EPROTO. Only optional notes inline - no need to re-spin for them.

commit.subject: LU-17000 brw: validate ioo_bufcnt against the niobuf array
commit.message:
LU-17000 brw: validate ioo_bufcnt against the niobuf array

tgt_io_data_unpack() bounds ioo_bufcnt only by PTLRPC_MAX_BRW_PAGES,
never against the number of niobufs the client actually sent.
tgt_brw_write() compares the two for writes, but nothing does for
reads, so a request claiming more of them reads past the end of the
RMF_NIOBUF_REMOTE buffer in ofd_preprw_read(), mdt_preprw_read(),
ofd_rw_hpreq_lock_match() and ofd_rw_hpreq_check().  Compare them in
tgt_io_data_unpack(), which runs before the high-priority handlers
that would otherwise overread.
